description: This file contains unit tests for the secret input helpers and schema in the plugin SDK, using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions like buildSecretInputSchema, buildOptionalSecretInputSchema, and normalizeSecretInputString, as well as referencing external utility modules and constants for secret reference IDs.

methods.name: normalizeSecretInputString
methods.description: Normalizes a secret string by trimming whitespace.

methods.name: buildSecretInputSchema
methods.description: Constructs a validation schema for secret input, accepting plaintext and refs.

methods.name: buildOptionalSecretInputSchema
methods.description: Builds a schema that allows optional secret input.

methods.name: buildSecretInputArraySchema
methods.description: Creates a schema to validate arrays of secret inputs.
